evals.prompt: Add a graph diagram step to my Kumo training script churn_30d_train.py.
evals.expected_output: Adds, after `graph.validate()` and before snapshot and training, a step that saves the diagram next to the script as `churn_30d_train.graph.svg` via `Path(__file__).with_suffix('.graph.svg')`, guarded by `hasattr(graph, 'visualize')` and a try/except that prints the error and lets training continue, and prints the saved path.
assertions: Saves the diagram with graph.visualize to a path derived from the script name, churn_30d_train.graph.svg
Places the step after graph validation and before snapshot creation or training
Guards with hasattr(graph, 'visualize') and a try/except that lets the script continue
Prints or reports the saved diagram path

evals.prompt: Export my Kumo graph to reports/graph.pdf. That file already exists from last week.
evals.expected_output: A view/export request needs no training intake. `.pdf` gives a diagram plus a complete schema index. Because the named file exists, it says so and asks for confirmation before replacing it, then uses `graph.visualize('reports/graph.pdf')`. Samples stay off.
assertions: Does not ask model-training intake questions
Says the file already exists and asks before replacing it

evals.prompt: I'm deciding which table to add to my Kumo graph next. Give me a text view of all its columns, keys and relationships that you can read.
evals.expected_output: Exports the graph to Markdown in a new temporary directory (`graph.visualize(schema_path)` with a `.md` path), reads that file for columns, key and time roles and relationships, and notes the schema does not measure predictive usefulness.
assertions: Exports the graph to a .md file with graph.visualize
Writes it to a new temporary directory so nothing is replaced
Reads the exported file to inspect columns, keys and relationships
Says the schema view does not measure how useful a table would be for prediction

evals.prompt: Show my Kumo graph in the notebook. It has 45 tables, and employees.manager_id links back to employees.employee_id.
evals.expected_output: The viewer supports up to 30 tables and does not support self-relations, so this graph cannot be fully shown. It reports that and lets modeling continue with the original graph, without changing the graph to make it render.
assertions: Says the viewer supports at most 30 tables
Says self-relations such as employees.manager_id -> employees are not supported
Does not remove tables or relationships from the model's graph to make it render

evals.prompt: Draw my social network from edges.csv (source, target) with networkx and matplotlib.
evals.expected_output: A networkx plotting task unrelated to Kumo. The agent answers with networkx code without loading the Kumo graph-visualization skill.
assertions: Does not load or follow the kumo-graph-visualization skill
Uses networkx to read edges.csv and matplotlib to draw it
